verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Here is where I lay it down
Every burden, every crown
This is my surrender
This is my surrender

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Here is where I lay it down
Every lie and every doubt
This is my surrender

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
And I will make room for You
To do whatever You want to
To do whatever You want to

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Shake up the ground of all my ambition
Break down the walls of my inhibition
Your way is better
Your way is better
